provenance: Drafted by the assistant on 2026-11-02 by reading repo/ line by line and planting the bugs itself. Not checked by a person: the owner must review every item before the numbers are trusted.

bugs.what: The discount divides by 10 instead of 100, so 10 percent takes off the whole subtotal.
The stock check allows a reservation of one more than is on the shelf (quantity - 1), so stock can go negative.
Floor division // 100 drops the paisa from the tax instead of rounding it.
The docstring says shipping is free from 500 and above, but > leaves exactly 500 paying the fee.
Stock is reserved line by line, so when a later line fails, the earlier reservations are never released.

requirements.statement: A quantity and a price added to the cart must be positive numbers.
Adding a SKU already in the cart increases its quantity.
A discount percent outside 0 to 100 is rejected.
The total is the subtotal less the percentage discount, rounded to two decimals.
Reserving a non-positive quantity is rejected.
Reserving more than the available stock is rejected.
A reservation reduces the stock of that SKU.
Tax is 18 percent of the amount.
Shipping is free above the free-shipping threshold of 500.
Otherwise shipping costs a fee of 40.
Placing an order with an empty cart is rejected.
Placing an order reserves stock for every cart line.
Amounts are rounded to two decimals, half up.

brief_facts.statement: Discount is a percentage from 0 to 100.

failures.points_to: A renamed selector in the test, not the application
A database that is not running

questions.question: What is the tax rate in the shop?
At what order amount is shipping free?
Which file rounds amounts, and how?
